answer: Coordination Horizon Pricing: each agent pays a per-action toll that rises with the number of distinct identities acting within the same short window, measured against a rolling baseline. Sybils cannot hide: splitting a swarm across many keys lifts the tide of counted actors and multiplies the toll each one owes. An attacker must fund every identity continuously, and the raven clause flags accounts whose activity cluster persists past the pricing horizon, freezing their toll credit. Concrete cost: funding N identities costs N times the surging per-action rate, sustained indefinitely.
